name: SB-53 Incineration Droid
description: The SB-53 Incineration Droid was a model of three-legged battle droid used by the the Shroud, a freelance spy active during the Galactic War. SB-53 Incineration Droids were among the forces stationed at the ruptured vault under the command of the Shroud's lieutenant Peej.
